nodes.description: payable function bet() that checks a pseudo-random condition, msg.value == 1 ether and !locked, then sends 2 ether to msg.sender via an unbounded external call.
function lock() that sets the locked mutex flag to true when the caller is gameOwner.
function unlock() that sets the locked mutex flag to false when the caller is gameOwner.
function own(address) that assigns gameOwner when gameOwner is zero or equals msg.sender.
function releaseFunds(uint) that sends amount * 1 ether to msg.sender through an unbounded external call when caller is gameOwner.
view function random() returning a uint8 derived from keccak256 of block.timestamp and block.difficulty; predictable timestamp-based randomness.
payable fallback function that forwards all plain calls to bet().
address state variable holding the contract owner, used for access checks in lock, unlock, own and releaseFunds.
bool state variable acting as a reentrancy mutex, read in bet() and written by lock()/unlock().
Caller-controlled address used for the payout target and for owner authorization checks.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used as entropy in random().
msg.sender.call.value(2 ether)() in bet(); unbounded external call after condition check enabling reentrancy.
msg.sender.call.value(amount * 1 ether)() in releaseFunds(); unbounded external call enabling reentrancy.
amount * (1 ether) multiplication in releaseFunds() that can overflow with no SafeMath protection.
address parameter owner of own(), assigned to gameOwner.
uint parameter amount of releaseFunds(), user-controlled value multiplied by 1 ether.

edges.reason: bet() executes the external value call to msg.sender at the end of its body, exposing the function to reentrancy.
msg.sender is the recipient of the low-level call in bet(), letting the untrusted caller re-enter.
releaseFunds() performs the external value call to msg.sender, exposing it to reentrancy.
msg.sender is the target of the low-level call in releaseFunds(), enabling re-entrant behaviour.
releaseFunds() computes amount * (1 ether) without overflow checks.
Untrusted amount parameter flows directly into the amount * 1 ether multiplication.
msg.sender is compared against gameOwner in lock, unlock, own and releaseFunds, driving the authorization logic.
The owner parameter of own() is written into the gameOwner privilege variable.
bet() reads the locked mutex variable as a guard before performing the payout.
lock() writes the locked mutex variable to true.
unlock() writes the locked mutex variable to false.
random() derives its output from block.timestamp, a miner-controllable value, making the bet outcome timestamp dependent.
bet() invokes random() and its outcome controls whether the payout occurs.
The payable fallback function forwards execution to bet().
own() writes the gameOwner privilege variable based on the caller check.
lock() reads gameOwner to authorize the caller.
unlock() reads gameOwner to authorize the caller.
releaseFunds() reads gameOwner to authorize the caller before payout.

normalization_plan.reason: The owner parameter is only meaningful as the input of own() and can be folded into that function node.
The amount parameter is only used to feed the amount * 1 ether arithmetic unsafe operation and can be merged into it.
